2.2 Assembly overview - toothed belt
Demo 2008 ➤, Demo Sedan 2016 ➤
4-cylinder diesel engine (2.0 l) - Edition 01.2020
140 Rep. gr.15 - Cylinder head, valve gear

1 - Bolt
❑ Renew after removal
❑ Do not additionally oil
the thread and shoulder
❑ 180 Nm +135°
2 - Crankshaft pulley
❑ Contact surface must be
free from oil
3 - Nut
❑ 20 Nm
4 - Idler roller
5 - Stud
❑ 15 Nm
❑ Renew only if damaged
6 - Nut
❑ Renew after removal
❑ 20 Nm +45°
7 - Tensioning pulley
8 - Toothed belt
❑ Check for wear
❑ Removing ⇒ page 149
9 - Seal
❑ Renew after re‐
moval
